author: Kevin Kelly
short: Export server chats privately into readable files for ChatGPT.
description: Administrator-requested exports of accessible text/voice chats, forum posts, active and archived threads. Produce chronological UTF-8 transcripts, structured JSONL records and a channel/completeness index in bounded independent ZIP volumes. Include date filters, bot filtering, progress, cancellation, private retries and automatic cleanup. Preserve replies, authors, timestamps, reactions and attachment links without downloading media.
install_msg: Load with [p]load exportplus. Use [p]export server or [p]export channel #chat. Enable Message Content and grant View Channel / Read Message History on the source channels. Files and progress arrive privately by DM; allow server DMs first. Use [p]export text 1 for a direct ChatGPT text upload. As the bot owner run [p]slash enablecog exportplus and [p]slash sync. See the README for filters, access and temporary-file limits.
end_user_data_statement: On an administrator's explicit request this cog reads accessible server message history. Temporary files contain message text, author names and IDs, timestamps, channel IDs/names, reply references, reactions, embeds, stickers, polls and attachment metadata/links. Attachment binaries are not downloaded. Files are privately sent to the requester and cached on the bot for at most 24 hours, or until cleared, replaced, reloaded or unloaded. Disk use is bounded. No chat data or bot credentials are stored in Red Config. User-data exports return only that author's retained message records; a user-data deletion request cancels and clears only exports requested by that user or containing their authored rows. In-flight unaffected exports omit that author after deletion; temporary exclusion IDs are bounded and erased with each job. Copies already downloaded or delivered to Discord remain with their recipients.
